perks.name: Overflow

perks.name: Cluster Bomb
perks.description: Rockets spawn cluster bombs upon detonation.

enhanced.name: Cluster Bomb
enhanced.description: Rockets spawn cluster bombs upon detonation. Blast radius is increased.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.description: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

enhanced.name: Demolitionist
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon generate an improved amount of grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Envious Arsenal
perks.description: Dealing damage with both other weapons before readying this weapon refills it from reserves.

enhanced.name: Envious Arsenal
enhanced.description: Dealing damage with both other weapons before readying this weapon refills it from reserves. Increases ammo generation.

perks.name: Incandescent
perks.description:
Defeating a target spreads scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.

enhanced.name: Incandescent
enhanced.description:
Defeating a target spreads a longer lasting scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.

perks.name: Collective Demolition
perks.description:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of grenade energy generation on hit. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

enhanced.name: Collective Demolition
enhanced.description:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of improved grenade energy generation on hit. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

perks.name: Blast Distributor
perks.description: Dealing splash damage grants a bonus to Grenade stat.

enhanced.name: Blast Distributor
enhanced.description: Dealing splash damage grants an improved bonus to Grenade stat.

perks.name: Bipod
perks.description: Increases ammo and reserves but reduces damage, blast radius, and reload speed.

enhanced.name: Bipod
enhanced.description: Increases ammo and reserves but reduces damage. Blast radius and reload speed are slightly reduced.

perks.name: Collective Action
perks.description:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of increased damage. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

enhanced.name: Collective Action
enhanced.description:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of further increased damage. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

perks.name: Elemental Honing
perks.description: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

enhanced.name: Elemental Honing
enhanced.description: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus for an improved duration. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Lasting Impression
perks.description: Rockets attach on impact and detonate after a delay. Increases blast radius and damage.

enhanced.name: Lasting Impression
enhanced.description: Rockets attach on impact and detonate after a delay. Substantially increases blast radius and increases damage.

perks.name: Explosive Light
perks.description: Picking up an Orb of Power increases the next projectile's blast radius and damage.

enhanced.name: Explosive Light
enhanced.description: Picking up an Orb of Power increases the next projectile's blast radius and damage. Increases the stack count limit.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.description: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

enhanced.name: Vorpal Weapon

perks.name: Bait and Switch

enhanced.name: Bait and Switch

perks.name: Aggregate Charge
perks.description: This weapon deals more damage for each elemental debuff applied to the target.

enhanced.name: Aggregate Charge
enhanced.description: This weapon deals more damage for each elemental debuff applied to the target. Damage bonus is increased.

perks.name: Binary Orbit
perks.description: Elemental final blows opposite this weapon increase damage for a short duration. Darkness final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Light final blows boost Stasis, Strand, and Kinetic weapons.

enhanced.name: Binary Orbit
enhanced.description: Elemental final blows opposite this weapon increase damage for an improved duration. Darkness final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Light final blows boost Stasis, Strand, and Kinetic weapons.

flavor: The Hezen Axis Mind is tireless and infinite. While it cannot be stopped… it can be paused.
